recurring_error_patterns_identified_in_p.description: Confusing developer sandbox/portal access with production self-serve availability (e.g. DealCloud, SFCC).
recurring_error_patterns_identified_in_p.remediation: Mandate distinction between developer sandbox and production org licensing. Mark enterprise-only as CONTACT_SALES.

recurring_error_patterns_identified_in_p.description: Assuming public developer app creation grants immediate API ad spend access without partner review (e.g. LinkedIn Ads MDP).
recurring_error_patterns_identified_in_p.remediation: Classify developer platforms requiring formal partner program vetting as PARTNER_GATED and BLOCKED.

recurring_error_patterns_identified_in_p.description: Classifying community hobbyist GitHub repositories as OFFICIAL vendor MCP servers or vice-versa (e.g. Sentry).
recurring_error_patterns_identified_in_p.remediation: Audit organization name against verified vendor domains before setting MCP status to OFFICIAL vs COMMUNITY.

recurring_error_patterns_identified_in_p.description: Labeling open-source CLI utilities (Mermaid CLI) as REST APIs instead of CLI binaries.
recurring_error_patterns_identified_in_p.remediation: Permit 'CLI' in api_types and mark credential_access as SELF_SERVE_FREE with mcp_status NOT_APPLICABLE / COMMUNITY.
